author: ConorMCGregorMMA
body:
IGN - Tameee
I was banned for DDoS Threats
Date - 20th January 2015
Well here's the story - I was on a nebula game i think it's called? And this guy is threatening people with DDoS everytime he gets killed (I don't remember his name) then i killed him and he threatens. So in defense i say "My friends can DDoS so if anything happens to me then i will tell him" something like that.
Why should i be unbanned - I think i should be unbanned because i am legit (pvp wise) and i have learnt not to mention DDoS to people even if they threaten me.

-Tameee
